items.title: SK Hynix (KOSE:A000660) Unveils Open AI Memory Standard Through New HBF Spec
items.summary: SK hynix (KOSE:A000660) and Sandisk have released a new High Bandwidth Flash technical specification through the Open Compute Project. The High Bandwidth Flash standard is designed for AI inference systems and targets high bandwidth and high capacity memory and storage use cases. The open specification gives system designers a common framework for integrating AI focused memory technologies across future infrastructure.
